messages:
nina: FYI opened PR to add Cobalt-30B model card + catalog entry. includes supported precisions, recommended quantization, and a short embed-dim note. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4277 :sparkles:

alex: saw the bench results in the PR. two quick asks: 1) can we add latency numbers at 4k tokens (not just 512/2k)? 2) call out that 4-bit quant gives ~1.8x throughput but degrades exact-match on our rerank test by ~2.3% so it's a tradeoff.

nina: good call — i can paste the 4k numbers. ran on dedicated 4xA100 (serial): 512 -> 480 req/s, 2k -> 172 req/s, 4k -> 78 req/s (p95 latency: 512: 110ms, 2k: 380ms, 4k: 820ms). will add a brief sentence about the rerank drop and link to the eval notebook.

marcel: small model-compat note: tokenizer for Cobalt uses a custom BPE merge table. when folks do prefix caching we should warn about token-count variance vs standard GPT BPE. can we add a "tokenizer notes" bullet?

nina: adding tokenizer bullet. any preferred wording?

sophia: SDK snippets nit: the node snippet in the PR uses `client.generate({model: 'cobalt-30b'})` — our JS SDK currently accepts `modelId` for create/stream endpoints (we changed the param last quarter). docs should match runtime. we should standardize to `model_id` for examples in the catalog to avoid confusion across SDKs.

nina: hmm — we intentionally used `model` because the python SDK uses that name. do we want catalog examples to show both variants? that might be noisy.

kevin: product preference: single canonical example per card is nicer. pick the server-side SDK name (python/REST) as canonical. can we make the REST + python examples use `model`, and add a short footnote: "SDK param names may differ (model_id/model) depending on SDK version"?

marcel: +1 to a footnote. also add a migration link to the SDK migration guide so teams can follow up.

nina: updated PR: python + curl use `model`, node snippet shows `model_id` and there is a footnote + migration link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/blob/main/guides/sdk-migration.md#model-param. also fixed a broken internal anchor that alex mentioned earlier.

alex: thanks — one more: the embdding vector dim listed is 2048 in the card but our embed service returns 256 dims for Cobalt-30B (we changed architecture). i think the card should say `embedding_dim: 256` and call out a compatibility note for downstream tooling that assumes 2048.

nina: great catch. i swapped the embed dim and added a compatibility note "legacy tooling expecting 2048 dims will require a migration step (see link)."

ops-bot: Canary deploy requested: catalog-only changes scheduled 2026-06-10T02:30Z. Please ensure ops-runbook updated if experimental flag is set.

kevin: should we mark Cobalt as `preview` until we finish the tokenizer/prefix QA?

marcel: yeah, preview makes sense. also add a short `limits` table row: max_context: 8192, recommended_batch_size: 4, realtime_streaming: supported (low-latency config).

nina: ok added preview flag + limits table. final call?

sophia: LGTM from SDK side; left one inline about consistent header order in the curl example (Auth then Content-Type).

alex: LGTM apart from a small wording tweak on the quantization tradeoff sentence. edited inline.

nina: thanks all — merged: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4277/merge. i'll open a follow-up to expand 4k/8k long-seq benchmarks and to add a small notebook showing tokenizer padding effects.
